recognize_zh: 周邊血液中有一個大型單核吞噬細胞，細胞質豐富灰藍並含一個小而緻密的圓形核（被吞噬淋巴球的核）與數個血小板；背景紅血球聚成不規則團塊（RBC agglutination），這是冷凝集等自體免疫溶血時的線索。
features: Large mononuclear phagocyte with abundant grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Two overlapping round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Phagocytosed small dense round nucleus (consistent with an engulfed lymphocyte nucleus) and a few platelet fragments in the cytoplasm
Background red cells forming irregular clumps (agglutinates) rather than rouleaux
Adjacent small mature lymphocyte and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows irregular red cell agglutinates throughout the background, with scattered platelets and a small lymphocyte. Centrally there is a large mononuclear phagocyte with two overlapping nuclei and abundant grey-blue, finely vacuolated cytoplasm containing a small dense round nucleus and a few platelet fragments, indicating phagocytic activity. No blasts or organisms are identified. Findings are consistent with a circulating hemophagocytic cell in the setting of red cell agglutination, compatible with autoimmune (likely cold agglutinin-associated) hemolytic anemia; the markedly elevated MCV and MCHC reflect agglutination artifact.

ddx.vs: Occasional phagocytes alone are not diagnostic; HLH requires clinical and laboratory criteria (fever, cytopenias, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, sCD25).

ddx.dx: Neutrophil containing an apoptotic body (LE cell-like)
ddx.vs: The engulfing cell would have a segmented nucleus and neutrophilic granules rather than two oval nuclei and grey-blue monocytic cytoplasm.
Rouleaux form linear stacked-coin chains, whereas agglutinates are irregular three-dimensional clumps.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm budding platelets, and tumor cells lack phagocytosed material.
